An oily bubble seeped from a long trusted gear and popped. Immediately, the wizard's\"}","{\"text\": \"attention was drawn to it and to the chain that tiny action triggered. A piston that had been thrusting left-right, left-right, for\"}","{\"text\": \"millennia suddenly began shifting right-left.
